parameters.query:
WITH batch AS (
  INSERT INTO processing_batches(business_date,status)
  VALUES (current_date,'PROCESSING')
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), selected_batch AS (
  SELECT id FROM batch
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id FROM processing_batches
   WHERE business_date=current_date AND status='PROCESSING'
  LIMIT 1
), claimed AS (
  UPDATE maintenance_requests r
     SET status='CLAIMED', batch_id=(SELECT id FROM selected_batch), updated_at=now()
   WHERE r.id IN (
     SELECT id FROM maintenance_requests
      WHERE status='RECEIVED'
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_batch)
      ORDER BY created_at
      FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
      LIMIT 50
   )
  RETURNING r.*
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM selected_batch) AS batch_id,
       c.id AS request_id, c.source_file_id, c.source_file_name, c.source_web_url,
       c.reporter_email, c.building_id, c.manual_ifc_global_id,
       c.camera_intrinsics, c.target_pixel, false AS no_requests
  FROM claimed c
UNION ALL
SELECT (SELECT id FROM selected_batch), NULL::uuid, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,
       NULL::jsonb,NULL::jsonb,true
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claimed);

parameters.query:
WITH existing AS (
 SELECT id FROM tickets
  WHERE building_id=$3 AND ifc_global_id=$4
    AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED','CANCELLED')
  ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
), item_upsert AS (
 INSERT INTO batch_items(batch_id,request_id,visual_evidence,localization,ifc_global_id,ifc_class,ifc_name,ifc_storey,ifc_space,duplicate_of_ticket_id,confidence)
 VALUES ($1::uuid,$2::uuid,$5::jsonb,$6::jsonb,$4,$7,$8,$9,$10,(SELECT id FROM existing),$11)
 ON CONFLICT (batch_id,request_id) DO UPDATE SET
   visual_evidence=EXCLUDED.visual_evidence, localization=EXCLUDED.localization,
   ifc_global_id=EXCLUDED.ifc_global_id,ifc_class=EXCLUDED.ifc_class,ifc_name=EXCLUDED.ifc_name,
   ifc_storey=EXCLUDED.ifc_storey,ifc_space=EXCLUDED.ifc_space,
   duplicate_of_ticket_id=EXCLUDED.duplicate_of_ticket_id,confidence=EXCLUDED.confidence
 RETURNING id
), duplicate_update AS (
 UPDATE tickets SET duplicate_count=duplicate_count+1, updated_at=now()
  WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM existing)
 RETURNING id
), evidence_insert AS (
 INSERT INTO ticket_evidence(ticket_id,request_id,evidence_type,source_file_id,uri)
 SELECT id,$2::uuid,'DUPLICATE',$12,$13 FROM existing
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
), request_update AS (
 UPDATE maintenance_requests SET
   status=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM existing) THEN 'ATTACHED_DUPLICATE'::request_status ELSE 'CLAIMED'::request_status END,
   existing_ticket_id=(SELECT id FROM existing), updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=$2::uuid RETURNING id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM existing) THEN 'DUPLICATE' ELSE 'GROUNDED' END AS outcome,
       (SELECT id FROM existing) AS existing_ticket_id;

WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT bi.request_id, r.source_file_name, r.source_file_id, r.source_web_url, r.reporter_email, r.created_at,
        bi.visual_evidence, bi.localization, bi.ifc_global_id, bi.ifc_class, bi.ifc_name, bi.ifc_storey, bi.ifc_space,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.building_id,bi.ifc_global_id ORDER BY r.created_at,bi.request_id) AS occurrence_rank,
        count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.building_id,bi.ifc_global_id)-1 AS community_reports
 FROM batch_items bi JOIN maintenance_requests r ON r.id=bi.request_id
 WHERE bi.batch_id=$1::uuid AND bi.ifc_global_id IS NOT NULL AND bi.duplicate_of_ticket_id IS NULL
), items AS (
 SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE occurrence_rank=1
), exceptions AS (
 SELECT r.id AS request_id,r.source_file_name,r.source_file_id,r.source_web_url,r.status::text,r.failure_reason,
        bi.visual_evidence,bi.ifc_global_id,bi.ifc_name,bi.duplicate_of_ticket_id
 FROM maintenance_requests r LEFT JOIN batch_items bi ON bi.batch_id=$1::uuid AND bi.request_id=r.id
 WHERE r.batch_id=$1::uuid AND r.status IN ('NEEDS_LOCALIZATION','ATTACHED_DUPLICATE')
), rules AS (
 SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY required_skill,severity) AS data FROM cost_rules c
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS batch_id,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i) ORDER BY created_at) FROM items i),'[]'::jsonb) AS items,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY source_file_name) FROM exceptions e),'[]'::jsonb) AS exceptions,
       COALESCE((SELECT data FROM rules),'[]'::jsonb) AS cost_rules,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM items) AS grounded_count,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM exceptions WHERE status='NEEDS_LOCALIZATION') AS unresolved_count,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM exceptions WHERE status='ATTACHED_DUPLICATE') AS existing_ticket_duplicate_count,
       COALESCE((SELECT sum(community_reports) FROM items),0) AS same_batch_duplicate_count;

options.systemMessage: You are the CBM end-of-day maintenance triage agent. Process the entire batch, not isolated requests. For every dispatchable item, classify severity, operational impact, safety risk, required skill and complexity. Calculate a recommended priority score and cost range using the supplied formula and cost rules; use the Calculator tool for arithmetic. Rank all dispatchable items from most urgent to least urgent. Review non_dispatchable_items too, summarize their risk and why they require localization or are already attached to an active ticket, but do not rank them as new tickets. Return concise decision rationales: cite observable damage, safety/operational impact, community-report count, confidence and cost implications. Do not reveal hidden chain-of-thought; provide only auditable decision factors. Never approve, dispatch, assign a technician, modify the IFC or close a ticket. Preserve every request_id exactly.

nodes.name: Validate Agent Output and Build Report

parameters.query:
WITH data AS (
 SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS x(
  request_id uuid, severity int, operational_impact int, safety_risk boolean,
  required_skill text, complexity_factor numeric, estimated_cost_min numeric,
  estimated_cost_max numeric, priority_score numeric, final_rank int,
  priority_label text, ranking_rationale text, damage_description text,
  ifc_global_id text, ifc_class text, ifc_name text, ifc_storey text, ifc_space text,
  visual_evidence jsonb, localization jsonb
 )
), update_items AS (
 UPDATE batch_items bi SET
  agent_classification=to_jsonb(d),severity=d.severity,operational_impact=d.operational_impact,
  required_skill=d.required_skill,safety_risk=d.safety_risk,complexity_factor=d.complexity_factor,
  estimated_cost_min=d.estimated_cost_min,estimated_cost_max=d.estimated_cost_max,
  priority_score=d.priority_score,final_rank=d.final_rank,ranking_rationale=d.ranking_rationale
 FROM data d WHERE bi.batch_id=$1::uuid AND bi.request_id=d.request_id RETURNING bi.request_id
), inserted AS (
 INSERT INTO tickets(request_id,batch_id,building_id,status,batch_rank,priority_score,priority_label,severity,
 operational_impact,safety_risk,required_skill,damage_description,estimated_cost_min,estimated_cost_max,
 ranking_rationale,ifc_global_id,ifc_class,ifc_name,ifc_storey,ifc_space,before_file_id,before_evidence_uri,sla_deadline)
 SELECT d.request_id,$1::uuid,r.building_id,'PENDING_FM_APPROVAL',d.final_rank,d.priority_score,d.priority_label,d.severity,
 d.operational_impact,d.safety_risk,d.required_skill,d.damage_description,d.estimated_cost_min,d.estimated_cost_max,
 d.ranking_rationale,d.ifc_global_id,d.ifc_class,d.ifc_name,d.ifc_storey,d.ifc_space,r.source_file_id,r.source_web_url,
 CASE WHEN d.severity=5 THEN now()+interval '4 hours' WHEN d.severity=4 THEN now()+interval '1 day'
      WHEN d.severity=3 THEN now()+interval '3 days' ELSE now()+interval '7 days' END
 FROM data d JOIN maintenance_requests r ON r.id=d.request_id
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
 RETURNING id,request_id
), evidence_insert AS (
 INSERT INTO ticket_evidence(ticket_id,request_id,evidence_type,source_file_id,uri)
 SELECT i.id,i.request_id,'BEFORE',r.source_file_id,r.source_web_url
 FROM inserted i JOIN maintenance_requests r ON r.id=i.request_id
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
), same_batch_duplicate_items AS (
 UPDATE batch_items bi SET duplicate_of_ticket_id=i.id
 FROM inserted i JOIN data d ON d.request_id=i.request_id
 WHERE bi.batch_id=$1::uuid AND bi.ifc_global_id=d.ifc_global_id
   AND bi.request_id<>d.request_id AND bi.duplicate_of_ticket_id IS NULL
 RETURNING bi.request_id,bi.duplicate_of_ticket_id
), same_batch_duplicate_evidence AS (
 INSERT INTO ticket_evidence(ticket_id,request_id,evidence_type,source_file_id,uri)
 SELECT s.duplicate_of_ticket_id,r.id,'DUPLICATE',r.source_file_id,r.source_web_url
 FROM same_batch_duplicate_items s JOIN maintenance_requests r ON r.id=s.request_id
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
), same_batch_request_update AS (
 UPDATE maintenance_requests r SET status='ATTACHED_DUPLICATE',existing_ticket_id=s.duplicate_of_ticket_id,updated_at=now()
 FROM same_batch_duplicate_items s WHERE r.id=s.request_id RETURNING r.id
), same_batch_ticket_update AS (
 UPDATE tickets t SET duplicate_count=t.duplicate_count+x.cnt,updated_at=now()
 FROM (SELECT duplicate_of_ticket_id,count(*)::int AS cnt FROM same_batch_duplicate_items GROUP BY duplicate_of_ticket_id) x
 WHERE t.id=x.duplicate_of_ticket_id RETURNING t.id
), req_update AS (
 UPDATE maintenance_requests r SET status='CONVERTED_TO_TICKET',updated_at=now()
 FROM inserted i WHERE r.id=i.request_id RETURNING r.id
), batch_update AS (
 UPDATE processing_batches SET status='PENDING_FM_APPROVAL',agent_report=$3::jsonb,report_html=$4,
   item_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM maintenance_requests WHERE batch_id=$1::uuid),
   grounded_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM data),
   unresolved_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM maintenance_requests WHERE batch_id=$1::uuid AND status='NEEDS_LOCALIZATION'),
   duplicate_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM maintenance_requests WHERE batch_id=$1::uuid AND status='ATTACHED_DUPLICATE'),
   updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=$1::uuid RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted) AS opened_tickets, (SELECT id FROM batch_update) AS batch_id;
